scope: Fresh original Win98 03 eleven-test run with the independently fixed supervisor-WP CPU and native power/saver disabled; cache corruption remains unresolved.

failedRun.selected: Original 4GT/2CPU/5feature, no sound; Win98SE 81.98,256MiB RAM,128MiB VRAM

nativeWrongRange.sourceEvidence: Physical EB4000 starts with a64-byte sequence matching XOR-decoded original GT2 hangar_low.msh at DAT offset159738380; this is a prefix match, not a whole-page source attribution. C3A000 and nearby incorrect pages contain runtime structures.

diagnosticCopyCaveat.nativeDumpBufferedAndNoBufferingReadback: Both NVDATA/NVMAP report f8b05a07 after FlushFileBuffers; raw mode uses aligned VirtualAlloc storage and FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING.
diagnosticCopyCaveat.snapshotCheck: Embedded tools-disk extraction matches live host output and both FAT mirrors are identical. This does not identify the cause of the native/host NVMAP discrepancy.
diagnosticCopyCaveat.policy: Use an exported copy as evidence of native bytes only when its independently computed CRC matches the native CRC. Do not infer source-cache corruption from the extra NVMAP dump differences.

helperChange.behavior: Check dump WriteFile result/length, FlushFileBuffers, bounded reopen ReadFile CRC, aligned nonbuffered CRC for sector-sized copies, and mapping CRC after WriteFile. Original benchmark/DAT remain read-only and unmodified.
validation: Real Win98 imports execute and all buffered/nonbuffered/post-write fields complete with END.

limits: The separate supervisor WP bug is fixed and independently tested, but this fresh run proves that fix alone does not resolve Win98 03 corruption.
Native passage beyond GT2 loading does not prove that the power setting caused the earlier wait.
The original Win9803 full suite, IQ and root-cause gate remain open.
